title: Sequential topology optimization: SIMP initialization for level-set boundary refinement
summary: Density-based topology optimization methods such as SIMP enable efficient topological exploration but produce diffuse material boundaries that require interpretation before manufacturing. Level-set methods maintain sharp interfaces but are sensitive to the initial design. This paper presents a sequential framework that addresses these complementary limitations through a signed distance function (SDF)-based geometry transfer, formulated for three-dimensional meshes.
